# All Clutch & Brake Service

> Adelaide's dedicated clutch replacement and brake repair specialist. Serving South Australia since 1984. All makes and models.

All Clutch & Brake Service is a family-owned automotive repair workshop based in St Marys, Adelaide, South Australia. We specialise exclusively in clutch replacements, brake repairs, flywheel machining, hydraulic rebuilding, and transmission servicing for passenger vehicles, 4WDs, and commercial vehicles. All work is performed in-house by qualified tradespeople — no apprentices working unsupervised, no hidden fees.

## Services

- [Clutch Replacement & Repairs](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services/clutch-replacement-and-repair-in-adelaide)
- [Brake Pad Replacement](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services)
- [Brake Rotor Machining & Replacement](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services)
- [Brake Caliper Repairs](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services)
- [Flywheel Machining & Replacement](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services)
- [Manual & Automatic Transmission Service](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services)
- [ABS Brake Repairs](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services)
- [CV Joint & Driveshaft Repairs](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services)
- [Log Book Servicing](https://www.allclutchandbrake.com.au/services)
